claim.claim-text: 2. The cartridge of claim 1, wherein the upper side has a second formation for releasably holding a second electronic device, the socket having a second socket thermal opening formed from the lower side to the upper side through the socket, the interface connecting the second device to the electric tester, further comprising: a second thermal post attached to the chuck, the second thermal post being inserted into the second socket thermal opening, an end of the second thermal post being thermally connected to the second device, such that heat transfers primarily through the second thermal post as opposed to the insulative material of the socket between the chuck and the first electronic device.

3. The cartridge of claim 1, further comprising: a circuit board between the socket and the chuck, the interface being located on the circuit board, the circuit board having a first circuit board thermal opening through which the thermal post is inserted.

4. The cartridge of claim 3, further comprising: a first set of contacts held in the socket and connecting terminals of the first electronic device to the circuit board, the first set of contacts being resiliently depressible to bring the first electronic device into contact with the end forming a first thermal surface of the first thermal post.
5. The cartridge of claim 4, further comprising: a plurality of pins that are mounted to the socket and extend through the socket to connect the first electronic device to the circuit board.

6. The cartridge of claim 1, further comprising: a lid that is movable relative to the socket to depress the first set of pins to bring the first electronic device into contact with the end of the first thermal post.

7. The cartridge of claim 1, further comprising: a first thermal anchor, the first thermal post extending from the first thermal anchor, the first thermal anchor having a surface contacting the chuck.

8. The cartridge of claim 6, wherein the first thermal anchor has a larger cross section than the first thermal post in respective planes that are parallel to an axis to the first thermal post, to improve thermal conductivity between the first thermal anchor and the chuck.
9. The cartridge of claim 7, wherein the first thermal anchor is inserted into an opening in an upper surface of the chuck.
10. The cartridge of claim 6, wherein the first thermal anchor is press fit to a select depth into the opening in the upper surface of the chuck.
11. The cartridge of claim 10, wherein the thermal post fits loosely within the first socket thermal opening.
